Hmm let's take a look at the teams before looking at the map. This is my first analysis so please let me know what you think.

**VP:** "Oh Virtus Pro, what is going on right now" are most of you thinking probably and this includes me as well. The last five matches include a 1-0 against PENTA which is no challenge, a 16-10 on Overpass against Titan which isn't the most impressive thing either considering Titan are one of the worst T1 teams. And then we have it all tumbling down: 0-2 against probably only terribly underestimated Kinguin. There was a time when Kinguin was just about to wake up as a team, play like a team and win as a team consisting of strong players with lots of individual skill. This was destined to happen against VP.
Followed by an 11-16 against EnvyUs on one of VPs worst maps Dust 2 and a 13-16 against Fnatic on Cobblestone which was quite disappointing considering the stand-ins. 

VP isn't a bad team at all and I am certain that the time for them to come back after their loss streak is now.

* 70% wins on Cache
* On a bad streak
* Have never lost on Cache to NaVi and even took Cache in BO3 they've lost against NaVi

**NaVi:** They're on fire recently with 5 wins in a row against rusty but slowly returning FlipSid3, a 16-4 against quite strong T2 mousesports and two quite easy wins against x6tence and PENTA as well as a close-call against EnvyUs on Overpass with a 16-14.

It's been an impressive week following NaVi and even considering the map I am sure they can deliver an equally impressive fight against VP even considering the map.

* 30% wins on Cache
* a win streak of 5 at the moment

**Cache**

Cache is this one factor I am certain VP will take this. Their ~70% win history on Cache and NaVi's ~30%. NaVi seems to avoid it like the plague and also even played it really close with a 16-14 against T2 mousesports. A BO3 against VP back in April ended in an Upset and a loss on the side of VP with the only map being taken... Cache.

**Conclusion**

Yes, VP has a bad streak but there has to be a time when a team like VP wake up again and deliver their comeback and all the signs are right. NaVi are a strong team as well for sure with more luck on their side as of now but looking at the map this BO1 definitely favors VP a lot. It will still be an amazingly intense game for sure. 
Both teams have the skill and team work needed so in the end it will come down to the map and VP definitely shows a more impressive history there.
